text: A song of ascents. I Viciously have they attacked me from my youth,let Israel say now. [AA]
Viciously have they attacked me from my youth, [AB]yet they have not prevailed against me.
Upon my back the plowers plowed,as they traced their long furrows. [AC]
But the just Lord cut me freefrom the ropes of the wicked. [1]
II May they recoil in disgrace,all who hate Zion.
May they be like grass on the rooftops [2]withered in early growth, [AD]
Never to fill the reaper's hands,nor the arms of the binders of sheaves,
And with none passing by to call out:"The blessing of the Lord be upon you! [3]We bless you in the name of the Lord!" [AE]
